name: Dumbbell Leg Curl
note: DUMBBELL NOT DRAWN: the rig can only attach a dumbbell to a hand, so the dumbbell held between the feet is missing from both pictures. Do not ship as-is without a label or a feet-held dumbbell prop.
research: Flat bench (deg 0) turned rot_z 180: pad top z 0.44 runs y -0.03..-0.85 (head end), seat y +0.01..+0.35 (knee end). Face down, root rot X +90 (head toward -Y). Chest ~0.18-0.20 m ahead of the pelvis joint -> root z 0.64; hip joints = root + Rx(90)(+-0.11,-0.051,0.003) = (+-0.11,-0.05,0.589). Thigh 0.45 -> knee joint y ~0.40 = 0.05 past the bench end (library: knees just past the end). Start: shin straight back, ankle (0.13,0.84,0.52), hip-ankle 0.89 m (~straight); foot rot X 90 = toes to the floor (ankle neutral, as when trapping a dumbbell). End: shin vertical, ankle (0.13,0.40,0.99): hip-ankle 0.60 m -> ~92 deg knee; foot rot X 180 = toes point away from the hips (still dorsiflexed). Knee pole below (z -0.5) keeps the kneecaps facing the floor. Hands grip under the pad near the head: elev 100, plane 85, elbow 80, forearm up; no prop. Hirose 2021 PMC7872291 (prone curl, hip neutral, 30/90 deg); Soga 2021 JSSM. The dumbbell between the feet cannot be drawn (see note). Facts and checks: research/dumbbell_leg_curl.json.
